summary: Validated balance reconciliation fix on preview: backend regressions phase47/48/49/50 passed, added extra bulk-contract regression, frontend build passed, and Playwright verified Label Management list available balance equals detail available balance for the same label.
action_items: Proceed to redeploy this preview fix to production.
Post-redeploy, run quick smoke on /api/admin/labels and /admin/labels first-row list/detail available balance equality.

Bulk computation uses one royalty aggregation + one active-withdraw aggregation for all labels, avoiding per-label N+1 queries.
No Mongo ObjectId leakage observed from /api/admin/labels response in tested scope.

rca of the issue: Reproduced by fixture-based regression in phase49 where stored balance (59,557,995) differs from source-of-truth computed balance (13,149,228).
